kpis.description_fr: Commandes annuelles GE Aerospace (moteurs commerciaux LEAP/GE9X + defense + services). Carnet en hausse continue, demande aviation civile et MRO post-COVID.
kpis.description_en: GE Aerospace annual orders (LEAP/GE9X commercial engines + defense + services). Steady backlog growth, civil aviation and MRO demand post-COVID.

kpis.description_fr: Moteurs commerciaux livrés (LEAP majoritaire, équipe 737 MAX & A320neo). Ramp-up production avec contraintes supply chain.
kpis.description_en: Commercial engines shipped (LEAP majority, equips 737 MAX & A320neo). Production ramp-up amid supply chain constraints.

kpis.description_fr: Part des services (MRO, spare parts, contrats long-terme) dans le CA Aerospace. Marges élevées, base installée 70k+ moteurs.
kpis.description_en: Services share (MRO, spare parts, long-term contracts) of Aerospace revenue. High margins, 70k+ installed engine base.

kpis.description_fr: Remaining Performance Obligations Aerospace. Visibilité multi-années équipements + services. Record historique.
kpis.description_en: Aerospace Remaining Performance Obligations. Multi-year visibility on equipment + services. All-time high.

kpis.description_fr: Moteurs LEAP (JV CFM avec Safran) livrés. Hero product, équipe 100% 737 MAX et ~60% A320neo family.
kpis.description_en: LEAP engines (CFM JV with Safran) delivered. Hero product, 100% of 737 MAX and ~60% of A320neo family.

kpis_story.description_fr: Programme CFM RISE (Revolutionary Innovation for Sustainable Engines) : architecture open-fan, objectif -20% fuel burn vs LEAP, entrée en service milieu années 2030. Réponse à la transition narrow-body next-gen.
kpis_story.description_en: CFM RISE program (Revolutionary Innovation for Sustainable Engines): open-fan architecture, target -20% fuel burn vs LEAP, EIS mid-2030s. Response to next-gen narrow-body transition.

_notes: GE post-spin = GE Aerospace pur. GE Vernova (énergie) et GE HealthCare déjà séparés. Focus aviation civile + defense + MRO.
